description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Moves one of the user's editable CVs to the trash (restorable for 30 days). Only when the user asked: the first call changes nothing and says what would go; ask the user, then repeat with confirm_delete true. The primary CV file is never deleted.

confirm_delete.description: true only after the user agreed, in their own reply, to delete this CV.

cv_id.description: Id of the editable CV to delete, from list_my_cvs.

name: delete_cv_variant
title: Delete one of my CVs
